snippet.title: Discounty: People or Profit? | Free Major Expansion Trailer - OUT NOW ON ALL PLATFORMS!
snippet.description:
📢🛒Attention shopkeepers!

The ‘Discounty: People or Profit?’ FREE expansion is now available on Steam, Nintendo Switch, PlayStation 5, PlayStation 4, XBOX Series X|S, XBOX One, Epic Games Store, and GOG.com! 🥳

This massive new update includes:

📖 A brand-new final chapter
📚 3 all-new endings
🏗️ Town restoration projects
🤝 New characters and trade deals
🛍️ Self-checkouts and online orders
🥫 35 new items
⚠️ Random shop events
🏠 New housing upgrades and much more!

Check it out now: https://bit.ly/4xCy7S3
